gates.name: Existing eXcor preserved
gates.evidence: Every change is additive to the public API; the full JVM suite and CI stay green

gates.name: Build correctness
gates.evidence: JVM tests, Android library, iOS arm64/simulator/x64 compilations and the shared metadata compile

gates.name: InnerTube operations
gates.evidence: Live: video metadata, search with filters and continuations, playlists, mixes, channels, comments, chapters; videoInfo falls back to the watch page when the bot check withholds details

gates.name: Player compatibility
gates.evidence: Live 2026-11-02: VISIONOS (no player script, no streaming token) answers OK with direct URLs for dQw4w9WgXcQ, and eXcor extracts from it. Its player request no longer sends youtube.com's Referer, which YouTube answers with 403. PlayerJsTest passes offline
blockers: The signature and n-parameter path (player script) has no playable response to test against here: the watch page answers with a captcha (HTTP 429)

gates.name: Streaming
gates.evidence: Live 2026-11-02 (LivePlaybackTest.extractedAudioDecodesFullyAndSeeks): eXcor extracted Opus/WebM audio for dQw4w9WgXcQ, the full 3,433,755-byte file decoded with ffmpeg without errors (213.06 s against a 213 s video), and a mid-file range read landed at the requested offset. The probe follows googlevideo's 302 to another allowlisted node
blockers: Most videos are still bot-checked or unavailable to every client from this environment (kJQP7kiw5Fk unavailable; JGwWNGJdvx8, FGBhQbmPwH8, 9bZkp7q19f0 bot-checked), so publicMusicVideosReturnRangeReadableAudio fails on its second video here

gates.name: SABR/UMP
gates.evidence: Not implemented. A serverAbrStreamingUrl now appears in VISIONOS responses here, but those responses also carry direct URLs, which play
blockers: No documented, independently usable SABR request specification; the direct URLs from the same response are used instead

gates.name: YouTube Music
gates.evidence: Live: search with filters and continuations, suggestions, artist pages, playlists, radio. Songs and albums are withheld from this environment
blockers: Songs, albums and discographies cannot be observed here

gates.name: Reliability
gates.evidence: Typed request failures (ExcorRequestException: RATE_LIMITED, SERVER_ERROR, NETWORK) after bounded retries; WARN diagnostics naming endpoint and status; bounded bodies, cancellation, failed-tab reporting, per-track errors, request budgets; all tested offline (docs/ERROR_HANDLING.md)
blockers: No fault-injection run against live endpoints; one full live run returned two unexplained nulls (passed on reruns), now diagnosable through WARN logs

gates.name: Developer usability
gates.evidence: samples/jvm-quickstart installs com.excor:eXcor:0.2.0 from mavenLocal per the README and runs live

gates.name: Release packaging
gates.evidence: Full publishToMavenLocal succeeds (root, JVM, Android, three iOS klibs) and runs in CI
blockers: No remote repository or release is authorized yet

gates.name: Competitive analysis
gates.evidence: docs/COMPETITOR_MATRIX.md: InnerTubeX from its README; YouTube.js and NewPipeExtractor from their READMEs (platforms, services, installation)
blockers: YouTube.js and NewPipeExtractor document no per-feature API list in the pages read; no black-box comparison yet

gates.name: Security
gates.evidence: URL allowlist, secret redaction in toString and logs, link destinations restricted to http(s), bounded responses; CI scans dependencies with OSV-Scanner 2.0.0, gating on shipped runtime dependencies (115 packages, no known vulnerabilities on 2026-11-02)
gates.command: see the 'Dependency vulnerability scan' step in .github/workflows/ci.yml
blockers: Report-only findings in Android lint tooling (guava, commons-lang3, httpclient, bouncycastle), which comes with the Android Gradle plugin and is not shipped
